extraction.Name: Morris Joseph Donville (Douville)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 5, 1918 by R. E. Wang
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Douville and wife for $600.00; then on April 20, 1918 conveyed by Douville and his wife to G. B. Roberts for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612677 issued; southeast quarter of section 26, township 36, range 31; receipt for patent signed by allottee January 12, 1918; land mortgaged March 1, 1918; also known as Douville
